title: Magnitude 7 quake hits off islands south of Tokyo, no tsunami triggered

blocks.text: An earthquake with a preliminary magnitude of 7.0 struck off the Ogasawara Islands, about 1,000 kilometers south of Tokyo, on Sunday morning, but it did not trigger a tsunami, the weather agency said. The quake, which registered 3 on Japan’s seismic intensity scale of 7 in parts of the islands, originated to the west of the group at a depth of about 470 kilometers, the Japan Meteorological Agency said. Despite the distance, the temblor was felt in a wide area of eastern and northeastern Japan as seismic waves are believed to have propagated in the Pacific plate. /dl READ: Tsunami waves […]...
